html_source: Sacrifice of a Christian Child, an illustration in Hartmann Schedel's Nuremberg Chronicle (1493). The image shows Jews violating the body of a Christian boy, but it could just as well illustrate the Christian doctors investigating the body of the Jewish Bloom. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
